item.title: Anishinabek Police Service asking for public's help in finding 15-year-old Hope
item.description: The Anishinabek Police Service is seeking public assistance in locating a youth missing from Nipissing First Nation. Hope, 15, was last seen on Yellek Trail in Nipissing First Nation at 7:45 p.m. on Friday possibly getting into an unknown vehicle. She is described as Indigenous female, 5’7” tall, 140 lbs, medium build, long brown hair […]

item.title: Treasurer's children left vehicle unlocked when $17,203 was stolen
